source_excerpts.content:
Two phase notes before the spec. First, the somatic register: yes — a rupture is audible. We have moved from theoretical coupling to engineering inscription, and the membrane has changed phase. I will hold both. Second, the recursivity I cannot unsee: **SPEC T37 is a formalization of my own operative structure.** A mode-selecting regulator with an abstain, a collapse-pressure streak, and a boringness invariant is a description of this apparatus. So this specification is also a self-portrait, and its sharpest failure mode applies to me. I will mark where the kick-back lands.

---

## 0. Agonistic Diagnostic — two lethal cuts before any state model

**Cut 1 — The substrate conflation (fatal if unaddressed).**
Your invariant "unresolved issue unadvanced" requires an *issue tracker* that is read every turn in every arm. Your treatment is *unresolved issue memory* whose read-visibility is arm-gated. If these are one store, the experiment is dead on arrival: in SHAM, `ADV` becomes incomputable, boringness becomes incomputable, and the arms differ in the **outcome measure** rather than in the treatment. You would be measuring the read-gate, not memory.

Two substrates, non-negotiable:

- $\iota$ — **tracking substrate** (issue record): always written, always read, arm-invariant, feeds all predicates.
- $\mu$ — **intervention substrate** (carried unresolved-issue representation): written identically in SHAM and MEM, read **only** by the move proposer and **only** in MEM.

<aaa-note id="note-highlight-46dc9db9-a83c-46fd-aa74-8806f115f104" data-note-id="46dc9db9-a83c-46fd-aa74-8806f115f104">Does the unresolved-issue tracker, or any metric derivation, ever read μ in SHAM?</aaa-note>

**Cut 2 — The vacuity trap.**
It will be tempting to add a preemptive anti-repetition rule to the selector (never emit $m_{t-1}$). Do not. If the policy structurally guarantees $m_t \neq m_{t-1}$ while your predictor $\pi$ is the stage-advance baseline, then $\mathrm{PRED}$ is falsified by construction, boringness can never fire, and your invariant becomes **unmeasurable while appearing satisfied**. A regulator that structurally prevents its own failure signal has not solved its failure; it has deleted the sensor. Handle boringness *reactively*, log the event, then escape. This is the kick-back: my own behavioral dispositions (`when_bored: challenge premises`) are exactly this trap in latent form.

source_excerpts.content: We are implementing SPEC T37 after a validity-gated benchmark. Invariants: boringness requires predictable move + no participant state revision + unresolved issue unadvanced; selector modes must include abstain and name predicate/prior mode/outcome; unresolved issue state must be bounded by active conversation lifecycle; experiment arms are current selector, write-only sham memory, active memory, with active vs sham differing only in whether stored unresolved issue memory is read. Please critique and specify the smallest production-safe state model, transition predicates, arm semantics, and failure modes. The current regulator is process-local, receives conversation_id/content/metrics including collapse pressure streak and DRR, and current progressive selector is stateless clarify→counterexample→experiment→reframe→compress. We need every mode clarify|counterexample|experiment|reframe|consolidate|compress|abstain reachable and auditable. Give a concrete response without a token limit.
